messages:
Ana (CS): Quick thread: Umbra's private/VPC dry-run finished. Blockers: 1) overlapping CIDR with their on-prem VPN, 2) CMK disallows our role for Decrypt, 3) audit-forward to their Splunk HEC fails with 401. Customer said this might impact renewal next week. Need P0 triage.
Ken (NetEng): What CIDR did they pick? I can validate overlap and propose fixes.
Ana (CS): They gave 10.2.0.0/16 which collides with their corporate VPN pool. They can't renumber this month.
Ken (NetEng): Short-term: deploy managed translation proxies (SNAT) in a managed VPC so we avoid route overlap; longer-term: Transit GW with route segregation. Proxy is faster but adds ~8-20ms and egress cost. I'll estimate.
Vik (Security): KMS: their CMK key policy only allows principals from their account and denies root. Our service call returned "AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt". We need their role ARN and to have them add our service role to the trust policy; also key policy must permit the assumed role to decrypt.
Ana (CS): They provided role arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/Umbra-RedwoodBridge but trust policy is CI-only.
Ken (NetEng): Vik, can you paste minimal trust policy snippet we can send to them?
Vik (Security): Minimal trust policy text to paste (replace PRINCIPAL with our service role ARN):
```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-service"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]
}
```
Vik (Security): Also key policy needs a statement allowing kms:Decrypt to that assumed role ARN. I'll add the exact snippet to the ticket.
logbot: Log forward attempt 2026-04-05T11:22Z to Splunk HEC returned 401. Response: {"text":"Invalid token"}. Forwarder role: arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/Umbra-LogPush. Log path: /var/log/forwarder/umbra-2026-04-05.log
Ana (CS): They rotated HEC token yesterday per their note. Likely mismatch. Also ensure the forwarder role has network permission to reach HEC endpoint (VPC endpoint or NAT).
Ken (NetEng): For the proxy option I can draft a one-pager with diagram + latency/cost. If legal needs guarantees around no public transit, proxy in mgmt VPC with SNAT keeps traffic off their carrier ranges.
Ana (CS): Umbra flagged this as critical for renewal. Can we mark P0 and schedule an internal triage today 16:30 PT?
infra-bot: Created ticket CUS-10244: "Umbra priv-VPC blockers: CIDR/KMS/Splunk" assigned Ken and Vik. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CUS-10244
maria (CSM): I'll join triage and loop in renewals/legal. Please prep owner list and ETA for customer update.
Vik (Security): Action items: I'll paste exact IAM trust policy and CMK key-policy snippet into CUS-10244 and include a short verification checklist (assume-role CloudTrail event, kms:Decrypt success, Splunk HEC push).
Ken (NetEng): Action items: I'll upload network diagram and proxy vs TGW cost/latency by EOD, and a minimal runbook for proxy rollback.
Ana (CS): Thanks. I'll draft customer update after triage and include owners + ETA. Umbra asks for a confirmation before their renewal call next Wednesday. :thumbsup:
